 162:/**
 163: * Normalize JSON from ESP image uploads. Shapes differ by endpoint:
 164: * - POST .../events/{id}/images 201 → bare Image
 165: * - POST .../speakers/{id}/images 201 → Speaker with `photo` (not `image`)
 166: * - POST .../sponsors/{id}/images 201 → Sponsor with `image`
 167: * See docs/backend-reference/openapi.json (uploadSpeakerImage / uploadSponsorImage).
 168: */
 169:function extractImageFromUploadResponse(
 170:  result: unknown
 171:): { imageUrl: string; imageId: string } | null {
 172:  const asPair = (v: unknown): { imageUrl: string; imageId: string } | null => {
 173:    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return null
 174:    const o = v as Record<string, unknown>
 175:    const imageUrl = o.imageUrl
 176:    const imageId = o.imageId
 177:    if (
 178:      typeof imageUrl === 'string' &&
 179:      typeof imageId === 'string' &&
 180:      imageUrl !== '' &&
 181:      imageId !== ''
 182:    ) {
 183:      return { imageUrl, imageId }
 184:    }
 185:    return null
 186:  }
 187:
 188:  if (result === null || typeof result !== 'object') return null
 189:  const r = result as Record<string, unknown>
 190:
 191:  let hit = asPair(r)
 192:  if (hit) return hit
 193:
 194:  hit = asPair(r.image) || asPair(r.photo)
 195:  if (hit) return hit
 196:
 197:  const speaker = r.speaker
 198:  if (speaker && typeof speaker === 'object') {
 199:    const s = speaker as Record<string, unknown>
 200:    hit = asPair(s.image) || asPair(s.photo)
 201:    if (hit) return hit
 202:  }
 203:
 204:  const sponsor = r.sponsor
 205:  if (sponsor && typeof sponsor === 'object') {
 206:    const s = sponsor as Record<string, unknown>
 207:    hit = asPair(s.image)
 208:    if (hit) return hit
 209:  }
 210:
 211:  return null
 212:}
